test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Aman and Rajan are working at a construction site. In some engineering experiment, Aman is constructing a wall, while Rajan is demolishing that wall. Aman can completely build the wall in 15 days, while Rajan will take 20 days to completely demolish the wall. In how many days will the complete wall be built for the first time if they work on alternate days, with Aman working on the 1st day?
solution:
**Given:**

Aman can build the wall in 15 days

Rajan can demolish the wall in 20 days

Aman works on the 1st day, and they work on alternate days

**Formula used:**

Work done by Aman in 1 day = 1/15

Work done by Rajan in 1 day = -1/20

**Calculation:**

Work done in 2 days = Aman (1st day) + Rajan (2nd day)

⇒ Work done in 2 days = 1/15 - 1/20

⇒ Work done in 2 days = 4/60 - 3/60

⇒ Work done in 2 days = 1/60

Let x be the number of 2-day cycles needed to complete the wall:

⇒ x × (1/60) = 1

⇒ x = 60

Total days for x cycles = 2 × 60 = 120 days

Since Aman works on the 1st day, he will complete the wall on the 113th day:

⇒ 113th day = 1st day + (2 × 56)

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
